name: Chord with a force-amplitude position step
tagline: One amplitude-conditioned position step and static lookahead and retention.
description: The position direction uses the unit-RMS branch output. Only the step size reads the original branch power through a scalar affine softplus. The velocity uses the complementary beta write.
mechanism: One positive token-dependent step from branch power
Spherical retraction and projected velocity mix
limitations: Research run with matched random output projections and a high Chord learning rate.
